retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait featuring a subject with integrated cybernetic facial plates and technical UI overlays against a solid vibrant background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man with cybernetic paneling integrated into his skin, surrounded by technical data displays, barcodes, and bold typographic elements on a flat yellow field.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's intense gaze centered against a flat, high-saturation background
Mechanical hardware integrated into the jawline and neck area
Large vertical typographic elements balancing the subject's head
Technical UI elements and barcodes distributed as facial tattoos or overlays
coreInvariants: Cybernetic panel lines following facial bone structure
High-contrast yellow and black color palette
Technical HUD elements like barcodes and serial numbers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale headshot centered horizontally, slightly cropped at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark mechanical collar at the base of the neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the large vertical text on the left, then down to the technical details on the face and neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid yellow background providing high contrast for the subject and text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and White (Typography and UI highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with deep shadows in the subject's features.

letterConstructionRules: Large vertical characters use thick, blocky strokes with rounded corners
Secondary text uses technical, monospaced skeletons
Signature text uses fluid, connected script strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Kanji-style characters are simplified into thick geometric blocks
Display text is enclosed in technical frames or brackets
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, blocky geometric forms and fluid, organic handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical feel of the display text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with cybernetic panel lines on his face and a mechanical collar, set against a solid yellow background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white blocky vertical text on the left, a red script signature on the bottom right, and technical HUD elements like barcodes and small serial numbers across the face.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant yellow?
Are the cybernetic lines integrated into the facial anatomy?
Is there a clear contrast between the blocky text and the script text?
Are technical UI elements like barcodes present?

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of mechanical parts with skin

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness of the face under the cybernetics
Ensure text does not obscure critical facial features like eyes
Verify that the yellow background is uniform and flat
Confirm the mechanical collar looks integrated rather than floating
recipe.reuseFormula: Cybernetic Portrait = (Close-up Subject + Integrated Tech Panels) * (Vibrant Flat Background) + (Blocky Vertical Typography + Technical HUD Overlays)
